designs.name: Clay & Paper
designs.description: A low walnut platform with warm terracotta stripes, a graphic woven rug and light sculptural furniture. White closed bedsides and an open-arm chair keep the room bright; geometric paper art gives it a little colour.

bed.name: Tahoe · Queen Walnut
bed.availability: ₱142,000 for exact Queen / Walnut, excluding freight. Preorder; current holiday notice says 2027 delivery. Cebu service, freight and arrival require a quote.
bed.evidence: Official Philux queen dimensions and sizing FAQ, checked 23 Oct 2026. Shared seller gallery photo; it is not explicitly mapped to the walnut queen variant. Materials: Walnut option; exact internal secondary wood/material specifications not published.
bed.limitations: Separate headboard width and internal mattress opening/recess are not independently dimensioned. The complete published bed envelope is used for this conditional layout. Continuous support for a 50 mm mattress must be confirmed.
bed.substitution: This replaces shortlist option 3: that listing has a 150 × 200 cm variant, but its queen headboard width is ambiguous. The Tahoe preserves the low, broad walnut-headboard direction.

clearances.note: Chair to curtain reserve: 12.0 cm. Plant canopy and drawer operation need site review.
